stratagems.summary: An Agents unit just destroyed by shooting: a unit within 6" shoots back at the attacker

stratagems.name: EXECUTION ORDER
stratagems.summary: Precision against one enemy Character until your next Command phase

stratagems.name: HELLFIRE ROUNDS
stratagems.summary: Anti-Infantry 2+ and Anti-Monster 5+ (not on Devastating Wounds weapons)

stratagems.name: HEXAGRAMMIC WARDS
stratagems.summary: The attacker’s Psychic weapons gain Hazardous

stratagems.name: HYPERSTIMMS
stratagems.summary: +1 Toughness (an Eversor also gets Feel No Pain 4+)

stratagems.name: INVIOLATE JURISDICTION
stratagems.summary: On an objective: Feel No Pain 5+

stratagems.name: KRAKEN ROUNDS
stratagems.summary: +1 AP and +6" range when shooting

stratagems.name: LINE OF FIRE
stratagems.summary: Can shoot enemies engaged with friendly units, within 12" (Blast excepted)

stratagems.name: MASTERS OF THE VOID
stratagems.summary: Agents arriving from Strategic Reserves can set up in the enemy deployment zone

stratagems.name: ORBITAL OVERSIGHT
stratagems.summary: Can only be shot from 18" or closer (6" for a Lone Operative)

stratagems.name: PRIME TARGET
stratagems.summary: Re-roll 1s to wound against Characters (Assassins re-roll all against the Warlord)

stratagems.name: PSYBOLT AMMUNITION
stratagems.summary: Ranged weapons gain Lethal Hits and Psychic

stratagems.name: RAPID TACTICAL RELOCATION
stratagems.summary: End of the enemy Fight phase: redeploys next turn anywhere 8" from enemies

stratagems.name: RITES OF EXORCISM
stratagems.summary: A Daemon within 12" tests Battle-shock; if it fails, Agents get Devastating Wounds against it this phase

stratagems.name: RITUAL OF WARDING
stratagems.summary: Your objective stays yours after it leaves; Daemons cannot arrive 6" or closer to it

stratagems.name: SELFLESS BODYGUARD
stratagems.summary: Precision attacks on a Character pass to a Bodyguard model on a 2+

stratagems.name: STEEL HEART
stratagems.summary: Fell Back: can still shoot and charge

stratagems.name: STUN GRENADES
stratagems.summary: An infantry enemy within 8" tests for Battle-shock and gets -1 to hit this phase

stratagems.name: TRUESILVER ARMOUR
stratagems.summary: Attacks against it: AP worsened by 1

stratagems.name: VIOLENT ACQUISITION
stratagems.summary: Against units on an objective: Sustained Hits 1, Lance and Ignores Cover

stratagems.name: WILL-SAPPING SALVO
stratagems.summary: Sustained Hits 1 when shooting (a Culexus deals 3 Damage)
